question: What is the graduated business tax rate applied to manufacturing and food processing businesses exceeding PHP 6.5 million in gross sales?
answer: Wala akoy nakit-an nga impormasyon bahin sa Citizens' Charter tungod sa tanan nga mga negosyo nga nakahimo sa manufacturing ug food processing na nagkahiusa sa PHP 6,500,000.00 sa gross sales. Ang Citizens' Charter wala nga nakahimo sa mga nakahiusa sa manufacturing ug food processing businesses na ito. [S1, S2]

ground_truth: Manufacturers, assemblers, and processors are subject to graduated fixed taxes ranging from PHP 1,497.38 for gross sales under PHP 50,000 up to PHP 44,240.63 for sales up to PHP 6.5M. Gross sales in excess of PHP 6,500,000.00 are taxed at 46% of 1.0%.
